name: gateway-zulip
description: Zulip chat gateway. POSTs to https://<realm>.zulipchat.com/api/v1/messages with HTTP basic auth (bot email + API key). Stdlib-only — no third-party Python deps.

commands.send: Send a message to a Zulip stream/topic or private DM (positional: recipient text)
commands.status: Show whether the bot site / email / api-key are configured
